name: The Great Taboo: Systematic Erasure of Calamity History
description: Fearing mass hysteria and resurgence of Witch Factor corruption, continental authorities outlaw the speaking of the Witch of Envy's name, destroying primary texts and cloaking centuries in mystery.

name: Rise & Radicalization of the Witch Cult
description: Devotees of the Witches reorganize underground. While initial factions claimed peaceful ideological preservation, sinister influences like Pandora radicalize the syndicate into violent archbishops.

name: Institutionalization of Anti-Half-Elf Discrimination
description: Because the Witch of Envy bore silver hair and half-elven heritage, intense fear evolves into institutionalized racism, isolating elven settlements like Elior Forest from the outside world.

name: Consolidation of the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko
description: The religious theocracy of Gusteko fortifies its borders in the frozen north, worshipping spirits and enforcing strict purity doctrines overseen by the Holy King.

name: Vollachia Codifies the Principle of Iron and Blood
description: Succession wars in the southern empire culminate in legalizing the doctrine of the strong devouring the weak, giving rise to the Nine Divine Generals and ritual battle rites.

name: The Great Mabeasts Roam Unchecked
description: The White Whale drifts through fog layers devastating trade caravans, while the Black Snake contaminates entire soils, maintaining terror in uninhabited borders.
